reason: Sibling accessors are plain store nouns (jobs, outbox, processes, workflows). The runtime has no other listener accessor, because integration listeners are registered at compose() time. The docblock keeps the 'local, in-transaction' meaning.
notes: Zero call sites. Keep local_listeners if reviewers want the in-transaction vs integration-listener distinction in the name.

reason: The runtime holds only one journal (the D1 effect journal), and the store-noun siblings are jobs(), outbox() and workflows().
notes: TXP's 11 call sites are TXP's own DddKernelTestCase::effectJournal() helper, not this method. Conformance EffectHost::effectJournal is owned by that area; if it stays effect_journal, use effect_journal here as well so both read the same.

reason: Two-word noun; 0.6 already uses work_items (attach_work_items, ensure_work_items).
notes: TXP's call sites are WorkflowsKernelTestCase::workItems(), TXP's own helper.

reason: Ignitions exist only for workflows; the plural store noun matches jobs(), processes() and workflows().
notes: Shared vocabulary: 'ignition' (0.6 has_ignition, WorkflowIgnition).

reason: Already short. Uses the 0.6 fetch_ verb and the DBAL/PDO idiom. rows()/row() were considered but read worse beside execute().
notes: Interface name; all four implementations (PdoConnection, ScenarioConnection, FaultyConnection, ScriptedConnection) follow.

reason: Pairs with fetch_all.
notes: The inventory's 24 TXP call sites are Doctrine DBAL Connection::fetchOne, which is not this interface. Do not rename those.

reason: Three words, kept on purpose: this is the universal SQL/PDO idiom (LAST_INSERT_ID(), PDO::lastInsertId). inserted_id() would make readers translate it.
One word, pairs with begin() and commit(). PDO's rollBack casing is an artifact of camelCase.
notes: TXP's 2 call sites are Doctrine DBAL rollBack(), not this interface.

reason: Reads as a predicate, and it is the PDO/DBAL idiom. is_in_transaction is clumsy, and is_active (ITransactionBoundary) would mean 'connection alive' on a connection.
notes: Departs from the is_/has_ predicate rule. If the rule is strict, use is_in_transaction.

reason: Three words, kept: 'duplicate key' names the exact error (unique-key violation 1062/23505, not SQLSTATE 23000), which the docblock makes load-bearing. is_duplicate($e) would be vaguer.
notes: Assumes wp-adapters WpSchema::lastErrorIsDuplicateKey keeps the 'duplicate_key' term.

reason: Conversion verb, like the 0.6 to_/from_ pairs.
notes: Assumes symfony GlobPattern::toRegex becomes to_regex too.

reason: Returns the INSERT statement text, beside columns() and json().
The values of the SHARED column set.

notes: Internal; one call site (DurableRuntime::eventClasses). Symfony CompiledSubscriptionRegistry::knownFactClasses is a related name owned by symfony.

reason: Three words, kept: the container holds both services (set()) and handlers, so 'handler' is needed, and 'default' carries the host-wins (??=) rule. set_default would read as a default service.
notes: Internal; two call sites in DurableRuntime::compose.

reason: Pairs with to_db.
